Référence 5900802

Retour à la liste

Temps plein
Type de contrat :
Independant

Description de l'entreprise
HappeningIT is a company, recognized in the field of consulting and staffing, active in the placement of specialized profiles in IT, digital, but also in various other fields such as project management, administrative support, finance, technical functions and support roles.
We intervene both in the public sector and in industrial environments, with particular expertise in projects related to ServiceNow and digital transformation.
Our strength? A human-centered, flexible and quality-oriented approach.
We connect the right talents with the right projects, and provide personalized, transparent and careful support throughout the collaboration.
Description de la fonction
HappeningIT is looking for a hands-on Data Manager & Data Engineer (Expert level) to join a strategic digital transformation program within a public sector organization. The program focuses on document digitization, process modernization, and building a data-driven ecosystem using Azure Cloud Dataplatformen.
You will work in a complex, multi-actor environment, with responsibility for both data engineering and data management activities, across both on-premise and cloud systems.
Role & responsibilities
As a Data Engineer, you will:
Design and implement data pipelines (batch and real-time)
Migrate data from on-premise systems to Azure Cloud Dataplatformen
Set up secure, scalable data integration and data Storage architectures
Ensure robust data transformation and integration processes
Support the collection and processing of structured and unstructured data
Build solutions for data access, including APIs and secure endpoints
Develop reports and dashboards using Power BI and SAP BO
Apply data security policies and participate in access control implementations
Support predictive and prescriptive analytics use cases
As a Data manager, you will:
Define and maintain a business glossary and data dictionary
Implement frameworks for master data and metadata management
Lead efforts in data governance and ensure data quality across domains
Collaborate with business units to align on data definitions and usage
Contribute to building a data-driven culture across the organization
Provide recommendations on data policies, standards, and lifecycle management
Help define KPIs and structure data for analytical and operational reporting
Act as liaison between technical teams and non-technical stakeholders
Required experience
We are looking for a profile with the following mandatory skills:
Data Engineering - Expert
Data Management - Expert l
Data integration and security
Data quality and governance
Data pipelines
Data migration
Data Storage and architecture
Data transformation and integration
Data collection and processing
Master data and metadata management
Power BI and SAP BO
Predictive and prescriptive analytics
Practical experience in Azure Cloud Data Platforms
Languages:
English: Professional level
French or Dutch: Good working knowledge required (bilingual environment)
Additional information
Workplace: Brussels (near major train station)
On-site requirement: 3 days/week minimum
Contract: Fixed-term, renewable upon positive evaluation
Only hands-on profiles will be considered — no consultants or project managers.
